maps.label: Deye Hybrid — native-equivalent (matches built-in reader)
maps.notes: The only verified map in this repo — matches esp32_coordinator's built-in native Deye/Solarman reader (src/ModbusScan/InverterLive.cpp) register-for-register, confirmed against real hardware. Canonical reference for field names and the project's sign convention (grid_power +import/-export, battery_power +charge/-discharge).

maps.label: Growatt SPH-6000 (pre-existing example)
maps.notes: Pre-existing example map; provenance not independently re-sourced/cited in this pass. Superseded in practice by growatt_hybrid_gen4.json / growatt_hybrid_gen3.json, which are cited against community register tables — prefer those for new installs.

maps.label: SRNE HF2430U60-100 (RTU)
maps.notes: Pre-existing example map; provenance not independently re-sourced/cited in this pass. SRNE has no detection signature in InverterVendors.cpp — auto-fetch cannot reach this map today.

maps.label: Deye SG04LP3 — 3-phase LV hybrid
maps.notes: mod=0 (LV) register/scale variant of ha-solarman's deye_p3.yaml. Cross-checked address-for-address against evcc's batterytype:lv branch — exact match. battery_power sign flipped (scale -1) to the project convention, corroborated by three independent sources (ha-solarman raw value, evcc's own documented convention, and this repo's own verified deye_hybrid_native_equivalent.json applying the identical flip on the LP1 family's equivalent register).

maps.label: Deye SG01HP3/SG04HP3 — 3-phase HV hybrid (pre-firmware-1098 scaling)
maps.notes: mod=1 (HV) register/scale variant — same addresses as deye_sg04lp3.json, PV/battery power scale x10. Targets HV inverters on firmware older than 1098; evcc documents a third firmware1098+ variant with a different energy-counter scale (0.1 -> 1) that is NOT covered by this map — verify your inverter's firmware version before use, or the energy counters will read 10x low.

maps.label: Deye Microinverter (SUN-M60/M80/2000-G3, no battery)
maps.notes: No grid/battery/load telemetry on this device class (grid-tied PV-only microinverter) — pv_power (aggregate AC output) plus PV energy counters only. Per-string PV power omitted: only per-string voltage/current registers exist, and computing power from V*I would be a derived value, not a traced register.

maps.label: Growatt Hybrid GEN4 protocol (MIN TL-XH, MOD TL3-XH, SPH TL3-BH-UP)
maps.notes: IMPORTANT: this protocol generation has no native single signed grid_power or battery_power register — only always-non-negative accumulator pairs (grid_import_power/grid_export_power, battery_charge_power/battery_discharge_power). This map ships those raw pairs under non-canonical names; esp32_coordinator's InverterMapReader has no A-minus-B computed-field feature yet, so this map is TELEMETRY ONLY until that's added — the surplus control law will not drive off this inverter via this map (same as any map missing a canonical grid_power). Conflicts with the pre-existing growatt_sph6000.json on several addresses (grid_voltage, grid_frequency, load_power) — this map's addresses are the ones independently confirmed by two sources; growatt_sph6000.json's are unverified.

maps.label: Growatt Hybrid GEN3 (legacy) protocol (SPH 3000-10000TL-BL, SPH 4000-10000TL3 BH-UP)
maps.notes: Same grid_power/battery_power limitation as growatt_hybrid_gen4.json (see its notes) — this protocol generation also has no native signed combined register, only import/export and charge/discharge pairs. Telemetry only.

maps.label: Solis Hybrid RHI/RAI series (native protocol, RTU)
maps.notes: RTU, 9600 baud, slave id 1 (evcc default for this template). A separate 'Solis string/PV-only' variant was investigated but not shipped — its meter register addressing could not be cross-verified and was excluded per the no-invention rule, not a distinct series worth a second file yet.

maps.label: Sofar G3 Hybrid (HYD series)
maps.notes: G3 protocol only (LSW3/LSE3 logger, TCP port 8899, FC3/holding registers) — the older pre-G3 Sofar protocol (plugin_sofar_old.py) uses a completely different address set and is not covered. battery_power's sign convention was cross-checked against evcc for the per-pack register (0x606) but extrapolated (same file/section/naming pattern, not independently re-verified) to the aggregate 'Battery Power Total' register (0x667) actually used here — flagged as lower-confidence than the rest of this map.

maps.label: Huawei SUN2000 (+ LUNA2000 battery)
maps.notes: Sign convention confirmed IN-SOURCE (inline comments at registers.py:976-987: 'positive is importing/negative is exporting', 'positive is charging/negative is discharging') — already matches this project's required convention exactly, no scale flip needed. load_power/load_voltage and today_import/export_energy omitted: those registers exist in the source only under target_device=SDONGLE/EMMA (optional accessory hardware), not the base SUN2000.

maps.label: Sungrow SH-series hybrid
maps.notes: grid_power's native register (5600, 'Meter active power') already reads positive=import per its own source comment, no flip needed; battery_power's native register (5213) is positive=discharging and was flipped (scale -1). All 32-bit fields use big_endian_word_swap per the source's 'swap: word' directive. load_voltage, today/total_load_energy, and per-string pv1/pv2_power were omitted — no matching raw register found (load energy only exists as an HA-side computed template, not a register).

maps.label: Fronius Symo/Primo — SunSpec int+SF (installer setting: "SunSpec Model Type" = int+SF)
maps.notes: UNVERIFIED BASE ADDRESS: per-field offsets within each SunSpec model are exact (summed from the model JSON's own point sizes), but the ABSOLUTE addresses assume the common convention SunS-marker@40000 + Common-model-1 (68 regs) -> model 103 header@40070 with model 103 being the FIRST model after Common. This chain-position assumption is not verifiable without a live device or Fronius's own published register list and must be confirmed before production use (esp32_coordinator does not implement runtime SunSpec model-chain discovery). Meter unit id 240 could not be independently confirmed in either source repo (evcc treats it as a free user parameter) and traces only to this project's own pre-existing docs/INVERTER_MAP.md, itself uncited. grid_power sign (scale -1) is an assumption, not stated in the SunSpec source — verify against a live device. battery_power/soc omitted: SunSpec model 124 has no instantaneous power/SOC register, only RW setpoints. Requires the Fronius installer menu 'SunSpec Model Type' set to int+SF — the float variant (fronius_symo_sunspec_float.json) will silently misdecode if the setting doesn't match.

maps.label: Fronius Symo/Primo — SunSpec float (installer setting: "SunSpec Model Type" = float)
maps.notes: Same base-address/meter-unit-id/sign-convention caveats as fronius_symo_sunspec_int.json (see its notes) — this is the float-model twin, same offset-derivation method, no scale_register (float32 direct). Requires the Fronius installer menu 'SunSpec Model Type' set to float.

maps.label: SMA — native Modbus profile (unit 3, 30xxx range)
models: SMA Sunny Boy / Sunny Island / Sunny Tripower (native profile)
maps.notes: grid_power (register 30775, GridMs.TotW) already reads positive=import natively — matches the required convention directly, no scale flip needed. battery_power could NOT be sourced as one signed register: SMA's native profile splits it into two unsigned registers (charge/discharge), shipped here under non-canonical names (battery_charge_power/battery_discharge_power) — same computed-field limitation as the Growatt maps (grid_power IS available here, only battery_power is split). total_export_energy (register 30513) exists and is well-sourced but was excluded: it is a 64-bit accumulator and esp32_coordinator's schema has no 64-bit data_type. The int32 sentinel this firmware checks (0x80000000) covers SMA's primary native NaN; a secondary SMA sentinel (0x7FFFFFFF, per evcc's int32nan handling) is NOT currently caught by the firmware — worth a future firmware issue.

maps.label: SMA — SunSpec fallback (unit 126, int+SF)
maps.notes: Same UNVERIFIED BASE ADDRESS caveat as the Fronius SunSpec maps (assumes SunS@40000, Common model first) — not verifiable without a live device. grid_power sign (scale -1) is inferred from general SunSpec/IEEE 1547 convention (inverter W is positive when generating), not stated in the source — verify before trusting. battery_power/soc/load_power omitted — out of scope for model 101/103 (inverter-only); would need storage model 124 or meter models 201-204. Prefer sma_native.json when the device supports it — this fallback is the last resort.

maps.label: SolarEdge — SunSpec (standard) + proprietary battery/meter float32 range
maps.notes: Same UNVERIFIED BASE ADDRESS caveat as the Fronius/SMA SunSpec maps — not verifiable without a live device. Meter unit id collision unresolved: docs/INVERTER_MAP.md says SolarEdge meters use unit 1/2/3, but that doesn't disambiguate from the inverter's own default (also 1) — this map uses slave_id 1 for both. grid_power is the inverter's own AC output power (model 103 W), NOT a true net-import/export meter reading — genuine SunSpec-source polarity is CT-orientation-dependent and not stated in any cited source; treat with caution. battery_power/soc WERE found (not a gap) at SolarEdge's proprietary float32 registers 0xE174/0xE184 via evcc, no scale_register needed there. total_battery_charge/discharge_energy exist in evcc (0xE17A/0xE176) but are 64-bit — same schema limitation as SMA's total_export_energy, omitted.

maps.label: Victron Cerbo/Venus GX (com.victronenergy.system)
maps.notes: Best-sourced map in this batch: registers come from Victron's OWN published register list (dbus_modbustcp's attributes.csv), not a third-party reverse-engineering project, cross-checked against evcc's independent driver. Both grid_power and battery_power already match the required sign convention natively, no flip needed. L1-only (registers 817/820 for load/grid, 850 for PV) — under-reports total power on 2/3-phase installs (L2/L3 sit at 818/819/821/822, not summed here, schema has no multi-register-sum feature). grid_voltage/frequency/PV-energy counters omitted: those live on services with a per-installation dynamic Modbus unit id, unsafe to hardcode.

maps.label: Luxpower LXP/SNA hybrid (EG4 and other rebrands, RTU only)
models: EG4 6000XP / 18kPV and other Luxpower rebrands (same register layout)
maps.notes: Cross-checked across three independent community projects (see source, commit-pinned) — not confirmed on real hardware, hence unverified. RTU ONLY: the stock WiFi dongle speaks a proprietary framing wrapper, not plain Modbus/TCP. No native signed grid_power/battery_power register in this protocol — ships as unsigned split pairs (grid_export/import_power, battery_charge/discharge_power), telemetry-only, same limitation as the Growatt GEN3/4 maps. battery_soc omitted: input register 5 packs SOC (low byte) and SOH (high byte) into one word this schema can't decode. Full rationale: the map file's own notes field.
